summary: Discussion with nested comments, replies, and controlled reactions.
whenToUse: Showing a conversation and allowing replies to individual comments.
whenNotToUse: For an index of discussions, use DiscussionList.

props.name: comments
props.description: Comments and nested replies with unique ids.

keyboard.action: Activates replies and reactions; mentions can be navigated with the arrow keys.

accessibility: Replies are nested lists; each action identifies its comment and the reaction exposes aria-pressed.
responsive: Content and actions wrap; reply indentation is limited.
customization: Content and actions are provided by the consumer.
commonMistakes: Update the comment model after the callbacks; the component does not save or moderate data.
limits: No built-in persistence, moderation, or networking.
